digest.component_or_area: live Jira Cloud multi-project test suite
propositions: A read-only, S3-backed live Jira Cloud multi-project test suite is needed to cover real ticket volume and diversity from projects REB and DIG, which cannot be exercised by the DC harness.
The test suite must structurally enforce read-only semantics by monkeypatching all mutating AcliClient methods to raise JiraWriteForbidden, preventing any writes to Jira or the store.
The reconciler must correctly fetch and scope snapshots per-project from both REB and DIG via compute_snapshot, with bridge_preview running in dry-run mode (persist=False) to issue no mutations.
The test store is isolated with a throwaway S3 prefix as its only remote, using minimal store content with REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off, and is deleted in teardown to maintain isolation from production.
All Jira-touching test scenarios must assert that per-project issue counts remain identical before and after execution to verify no mutations occurred.
Unknown or unreachable project keys must fail closed by raising an exception during compute_snapshot, never silently succeeding.
